en.headline: Businesses in {region} whose IT needs are changing
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets companies around {ort} that were just registered, are growing or are looking for IT staff – the moments when email, devices and security get set up or outsourced.

signals.title: New companies
signals.text: A new business sets up email, devices, backups and security in its first months – ideally with a partner from day one.

signals.title: Open IT roles
signals.text: An IT support vacancy that stays open is a good reason to offer managed support instead.

signals.title: Checked and sourced
signals.text: Each lead shows the company, date, address and the source.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit an MSP?
faq.a: Managed service providers grow by signing businesses before an in-house setup takes root. The weekly list gives {firma} those businesses in {region}.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.
